advantages: One persistent process can own a deterministic vector batch

blocking_gaps: Only Vehicle A planar3 is implemented
Current implementation hard-codes float64, which MPS does not support

rationale: The bridge must preserve the production simulator across both dynamics models. Selecting the current tensor backend would silently substitute an incomplete simulator reproduction. The persistent batched Node service is therefore the reference bridge; tensor remains an optimization candidate that must independently pass parity before use.
prohibitions: No Node process per Gym step
No tensor result described as coupled6 parity until a coupled6 tensor plant exists
No local throughput number is paper measurement
